lines.japanese: こんこん
lines.english: Knock, knock.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、入るよー？」
lines.english: “Big Brother? I’m coming in.”

lines.japanese: うん……。
lines.english: Mm...

lines.japanese: という返事をするのが億劫なほど懶眠の中にいた。
lines.english: I lay sunk so deep in indolent sleep that even answering seemed too much trouble.

lines.japanese: 職務怠慢の目覚まし時計はさっき床の上にほっぽり投げた。
lines.english: Earlier, I had flung the alarm clock—an appalling derelict in its duties—onto the floor.

lines.japanese: 「わっ、こんなところまで投げたんだ」
lines.english: “Wow. You threw it all the way over here.”

lines.japanese: どうやら俺は返事をしてたらしい。小鳩が目覚ましを拾いあげて机の上に置く音がした。
lines.english: Apparently I had answered after all. I heard Kobato pick up the alarm and set it on my desk.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん朝だよ。起きないと遅刻しちゃうよ」
lines.english: “It’s morning, Big Brother. You’ll be late if you don’t get up.”

lines.japanese: 「今日は諦めよう」
lines.english: “Forget getting up today.”

lines.japanese: 俺は理性を総動員して相手に伝わる音を口から出した。
lines.english: I marshaled every scrap of reason at my disposal and forced intelligible sound from my mouth.

lines.japanese: 「そうやってすぐに諦めるのはもうダメ」
lines.english: “No more giving up the moment something gets hard.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は俺をゆさゆさとゆする。相変わらず眠気を増幅させるゆりかごのような力。
lines.english: Kobato rocked me gently to and fro. As always, her hands possessed the cradle-like power to deepen my sleepiness.

lines.japanese: 「ムリだよ小鳩、この力には誰も逆らえないよ。怠惰サイコー、怠惰オーイェ、怠惰バンザアアアイ」
lines.english: “It's impossible, Kobato. No one can resist this power. Sloth supreme. Sloth, oh yeah. Loooong live sloth!”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、もう起きてない？」
lines.english: “Aren't you already awake?”

lines.japanese: 「そういう側面もある。だがここから抜けだすのは不可能に近い。だってこのかけぶとん取ったら寒いでしょう」
lines.english: “From one perspective, yes. But escape from here verges on impossible. If I throw off this comforter, it'll be cold.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあエアコン入れてあげるよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “Then I'll turn on the heater for you. Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「うう、ムリだよ。部屋が暖かくなるまで、あと３０分は起きられないよ」
lines.english: “Uuugh, impossible. I can't get up for another thirty minutes—not until the room is warm.”

lines.japanese: 俺は繭に包まれる蚕のようにふとんでその身をくるみ込んだ。
lines.english: I wound the covers around my body like a silkworm sealed inside its cocoon.

lines.japanese: 「今から３０分も寝たら遅刻しちゃうよ。支度を３０分で済ませないといけないレベルだもん」
lines.english: “If you sleep another thirty minutes, you'll be late. You're already at the point where you have to get ready in thirty.”

lines.japanese: そのとき偶然とも言うべき数字の一致に、俺の頭に稲妻のような天啓が舞いおりた。
lines.english: At that moment, the accidental symmetry of those two thirty-minute spans struck me like a bolt of divine revelation.

lines.japanese: 「だったらふとんの中で支度を済ませればいいじゃないか」
lines.english: “Then I can get ready inside the covers.”

lines.japanese: 「バカじゃないの」
lines.english: “Are you stupid?”

lines.japanese: 妹は神の導きを一蹴した。
lines.english: My sister dismissed divine guidance out of hand.

lines.japanese: 「ま、待ちなさい、諦めるのはもうやめろと言ったのは小鳩の方じゃないか」
lines.english: “W-wait. You were the one who said I mustn't give up anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「言ったけど……でもどうやって？」
lines.english: “I did, but... how would that even work?”

lines.japanese: 「とりあえずおなか空いた」
lines.english: “For starters, I'm hungry.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 「この部屋まで持ってきてくれない？」
lines.english: “Would you bring breakfast up here?”

lines.japanese: 我ながら最低だ。でも繭の中にいる俺には、そんなこと関係ないやと思った。
lines.english: Even I knew I was the worst. But from inside my cocoon, I decided none of that mattered.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、仕方ないなあ……」
lines.english: “Hmm. I suppose I have no choice...”

lines.japanese: えっ、マジで？
lines.english: Wait, seriously?

lines.japanese: 怒られると思いきや、意外な反応に俺はふとんから顔だけ出した。小鳩が入れてくれたエアコンの送風が温かい。
lines.english: I had expected a scolding. At this astonishing response, I poked only my face out from under the covers. The air from the heater Kobato had switched on was warm.

lines.japanese: やがてとんとんと階段を上がる音が聞こえてきた。
lines.english: Before long, I heard her pattering up the stairs.

lines.japanese: やってきた小鳩が抱えていたものはお盆、タオル、洗面器。
lines.english: Kobato returned carrying a tray, a towel, and a washbasin.

lines.japanese: せん、めん、き……？
lines.english: A wash... basin...?

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、今日はパンじゃなくてごはんだけどいい？」
lines.english: “Big Brother, we have rice instead of bread today. Is that all right?”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、全然いい。先週はパンが多かったしね」
lines.english: “Sure, perfectly fine. We had bread a lot last week.”

lines.japanese: 「でもエアコンの風に当たってたら、のど渇いちゃった。お水もらっていいかな」
lines.english: “But this warm air has made me thirsty. Could I have some water?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Here.”

lines.japanese: 「ごはっ」
lines.english: “Gwah!”

lines.japanese: 俺の頭上１メートルくらいから小さな滝が落ちてきた。それは確かに俺の口内に入ったが、直撃した喉と拡散した水を浴びた顔への被害が甚大だった。
lines.english: A small waterfall descended from about three feet above my head. Some certainly entered my mouth, but the direct hit to my throat and the spray across my face inflicted tremendous damage.

lines.japanese: 「はやや、顔にかかっちゃった」
lines.english: “Oh no! I got it on your face.”

lines.japanese: わざとじゃないことに兄として心配を抱かずにはいられなかったが、かわいいから許してあげることにした。
lines.english: As her brother, I couldn't help finding it worrying that this had been an accident. But she was adorable, so I decided to forgive her.

lines.japanese: 「えへ、今日のおかずは鮭と玉子焼きとおみそ汁だよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Today we have salmon, rolled omelet, and miso soup. Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、純和風の朝食ってカンジでいいなあ」
lines.english: “Oh, nice. A thoroughly Japanese breakfast.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、今日はがんばってみたよ」
lines.english: “Yes. I tried extra hard today.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、あーんして」
lines.english: “Now open wide.”

lines.japanese: 「あーん」
lines.english: “Aah.”

lines.japanese: 俺の枕元に座った小鳩がお箸にごはんを乗せて俺の口の中に運んできてくれた。
lines.english: Kobato sat by my pillow, picked up some rice with her chopsticks, and brought it to my mouth.

lines.japanese: 「ふむん、もぐもぐ」
lines.english: “Mmm. Munch, munch.”

lines.japanese: 「次なにがいい？」
lines.english: “What do you want next?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ鮭で」
lines.english: “Salmon, please.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、あーん」
lines.english: “All right. Open wide.”

lines.japanese: 口の中に塩辛い味が広がる。体はぽかぽか。口はもぐもぐ。兄のために献身的な妹。最高じゃないか。
lines.english: Salt spread through my mouth. My body was toasty warm. My jaws went munch, munch. A devoted little sister tending to her brother. Could life be any better?

lines.japanese: 俺は自分が最低なことを承知の上で、自堕落万歳と心の中で喝采した。
lines.english: Knowing full well what a wretch I was, I cheered inwardly: Long live self-indulgence.

lines.japanese: 「あ、お兄ちゃん鮭にしょうゆはかけなくていい？」
lines.english: “Oh, Big Brother, don’t you want soy sauce on your salmon?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そのままでもいいけど、今日はかけて食べたい気分かな」
lines.english: “It's fine as it is, but I think I'm in the mood for soy sauce today.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、分かった」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: 口の中でしょうゆ味がいっぱいに広がった。ていうかまんましょうゆが落ちてきた。
lines.english: The taste of soy sauce flooded my mouth. More precisely, the soy sauce itself came pouring in.

lines.japanese: 「ごはあっ」
lines.english: “Gwah!”

lines.japanese: どうやらかけたものを食べさせてくれるのではなく、口の中で合成しろということらしい。だが残念なことにすでに鮭を飲みこんでいた俺は、ただしょうゆを口に入れられたにすぎなかった。
lines.english: Apparently she hadn't meant to feed me salmon with soy sauce on it. I was expected to combine the ingredients inside my mouth. Unfortunately, I had already swallowed the salmon. All she achieved was feeding me a mouthful of plain soy sauce.

lines.japanese: 「玉子焼きは？」
lines.english: “How about the omelet?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いい。そのままのプレーンな玉子焼きがいい」
lines.english: “N-no. I want the omelet plain. Completely plain.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。私も甘い玉子焼きが好きなんだ」
lines.english: “Okay. I like sweet omelets too.”

lines.japanese: そんなことを続けて、なんとか朝食を済ませることが出来た。ふう、大変だった。
lines.english: We kept that up and somehow managed to finish breakfast. Whew. That was hard work.

lines.japanese: 「はいっ、あーんして」
lines.english: “All right! Open wide.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぐっ」
lines.english: “Mmph!”

lines.japanese: その直後に棒を突っこまれた。口に広がっていた塩味は消え、代わりに医薬的な味に占領される。
lines.english: A stick entered my mouth immediately afterward. The lingering saltiness vanished, supplanted by a medicinal flavor.

lines.japanese: 「はい、はいっ」
lines.english: “There, there.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の手が動くたびにしゃこしゃこと音がした。朝食の次段階、歯磨きに移行したらしい。
lines.english: *Scritch, scritch* went the brush whenever Kobato's hand moved. Apparently we had advanced to the next stage after breakfast: brushing my teeth.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、ひとの歯磨きなんてしたことないから、ちょっと楽しいね」
lines.english: “Hee hee. I've never brushed somebody else's teeth before. This is kind of fun.”

lines.japanese: 楽しいのか。俺の初体験だからヘンな気分だった。
lines.english: It was fun for her. It was a first for me, and the whole thing felt strange.

lines.japanese: ただ、なんか、ちょっとエロい。
lines.english: And somehow it felt a little erotic.

lines.japanese: それも妹にされてるってのがまた……この堕落ぶりと相まって妙な背徳感を生みだしてる気がする。
lines.english: The fact that my sister was doing it made matters still more... Combined with the depths of my degradation, it produced a peculiar sense of transgression.

lines.japanese: ってなにを考えてんだ俺！　ヨージだ！　ヨージのアホの思考がどこかに残ってるからこんなことを考えてしまうんだ。この変態！
lines.english: What the hell was I thinking!? It was Yoji! Some residue of that idiot Yoji's thoughts must have been lurking inside me, making me think this way. You pervert!

lines.japanese: 「って俺じゃん！」
lines.english: “Wait, that's me!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあうがいように水いれるよ」
lines.english: “I'll pour in some water so you can rinse.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が洗面器を傾けると、大量の水が俺の口めがけて落ちてきた。
lines.english: Kobato tilted the washbasin, sending a great torrent of water straight toward my mouth.

lines.japanese: 「ごばああっ！」
lines.english: “Gblargh!”

lines.japanese: 「わあーっ！　ごご、ごめん、お兄ちゃん大丈夫！？」
lines.english: “Wah! I-I-I’m sorry! Big Brother, are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 顔が水浸しになったので、俺はようやく堕落な朝から脱却することが出来た。
lines.english: With my face thoroughly drenched, I finally escaped my morning of decadence.

lines.japanese: 結果、いつもの時間に家を出ることが出来た。ありがとう小鳩。ありがとう妹。
lines.english: As a result, I left home at the usual time. Thank you, Kobato. Thank you, little sister.
